changes.comments:
House Bill 25-1159, signed by Governor Polis on May 31, 2025 and effective March 1, 2026, updated the support schedule based on the Betson-Rothbarth Study and 2023 Consumer Price Index data. The previous schedule, based on 2010 economic data, significantly underestimated the actual cost of raising children.
Key changes include:
• Combined income cap increased from $30,000 to $40,000 per month
• Support amounts updated to reflect 2023 cost-of-living data
• New self-support reserve of $1,831.83 monthly (based on a $15.16 minimum wage × 29 hours × 50 weeks ÷ 12 months)
• Low-income adjustments restructured for fairness
